description: This file defines the API and data structures for managing submodule configuration caching in a Git-related project. It includes function declarations for retrieving, freeing, and validating submodule information, as well as handling submodule trees.

classes.name: submodule
classes.description: Represents a submodule with its configuration details such as path, URL, branch, and update strategy.

classes.name: submodule_tree_entry
classes.description: Contains information about a submodule within a tree, including its repository and configuration.

classes.name: submodule_entry_list
classes.description: A list structure holding multiple submodule tree entries.

methods.name: submodule_cache_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a submodule cache.

methods.name: parse_submodule_fetchjobs
methods.description: Parses fetch jobs configuration for submodules.

methods.name: parse_fetch_recurse_submodules_arg
methods.description: Parses the recurse submodules argument for fetch operations.

methods.name: option_fetch_parse_recurse_submodules
methods.description: Parses command-line options related to recurse submodules.

methods.name: parse_update_recurse_submodules_arg
methods.description: Parses the recurse submodules argument for update operations.

methods.name: parse_push_recurse_submodules_arg
methods.description: Parses the recurse submodules argument for push operations.

methods.name: repo_read_gitmodules
methods.description: Reads the .gitmodules file for a repository.

methods.name: gitmodules_config_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID of the .gitmodules configuration.

methods.name: submodule_from_name
methods.description: Retrieves a submodule by name from a repository at a specific commit or tree.

methods.name: submodule_from_path
methods.description: Retrieves a submodule by path from a repository at a specific commit or tree.

methods.name: submodule_free
methods.description: Frees cached submodule data for a repository.

methods.name: print_config_from_gitmodules
methods.description: Prints configuration data from the .gitmodules file.

methods.name: config_set_in_gitmodules_file_gently
methods.description: Sets configuration in the .gitmodules file gently (without overwriting).

methods.name: check_submodule_name
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a submodule name.

methods.name: check_submodule_url
methods.description: Validates the URL of a submodule.

methods.name: submodules_of_tree
methods.description: Retrieves all submodules within a given tree, excluding nested submodules.

methods.name: submodule_entry_list_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a submodule entry list.
